Are you more interested in prequels or sequels?

I like stories. Sometimes, I want to know about how a character arrived at the point that the story is being told (Gandalf must have seen some stuff). Sometimes I like to know what happened after (The Connors could have done a great job rebuilding the world)

It all matters how the story flows. I am certain I didn't want to know Annakin was a real neat Pod Racer. I wanted to see him as "the greatest Jedi" before he turned to the dark side.
If the original movie is a MILF movie then sure.
If the original has a nice conclusion then prequal. Forcing sequals is terrible.

I much prefer a story where the backstory is brought into the present to one that needs to go back to revisit it. The best stories are the ones that no one would want a prequel to because you already know everything that would happen in it.

Sometimes though you want to see it. Look at Game of Thrones and the Battle for the Trident and the Events that led up to the tower of Joy. Actually having a visual or written story go into the details of the battle and such would be fantastic given how much of an impact it made. We are given more than a gist of it as it stands but it would be a hell of a thing to read as it unfolds.
